subject_session: Achilles-10252013 (example) + Cicero-09012014, Cicero-09172014, Gatsby-08022013, Buddy-06272013 (5 linear-track sessions, 4 rats)

headline_stat.name: median circular-linear slope (deg per field traversal); % fields with negative slope

stated_limitation: Four of the 96 fits ran into the edge of the ±1.5 cycle search range; two of those still had a clearly negative correlation and two did not, and they were left in the tallies rather than removed by hand.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1 linear-track) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta phase precession, analyzed in the appropriate species, region, and paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with explicit, correct handling of the SpatialSeries rate/period quirk, an out-of-order spike, direction-specific fields, and transparent place-cell inclusion criteria.
justification.analysis: Uses the Kempter et al. circular-linear regression with a symmetric slope search and a marginal-preserving permutation null, plus sign and Wilcoxon tests, all correct for circular data.
justification.correctness: Median slope (-225 deg), median rho (-0.275), %negative (85.4%), and %significant (72.9%) reproduce exactly from the committed CSV; only a secondary 'both sig & negative' figure is off by two fields, immaterial to the conclusion.
justification.figures: Figures are labeled with units and sample sizes and show the effect at every level, from single-pass spike-riding to the pooled 24,901-spike descending band against a shuffle null.
justification.honesty: The write-up names specific limitations (edge fits retained, absolute phase not comparable across sessions, circular-maze sessions excluded), labels the example pass as 'the clearest' rather than typical, and includes weak fields (rho -0.17) in the gallery.
